source.publisher: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
source.title: Welfare of Building and Other Construction Workers for the period ended March 2022

say.text: This is the audit of Gujarat's welfare board for construction workers.
Its advisory committee lapsed in June twenty eleven, and was not set up again until March twenty twenty-two. The board itself has held no meetings since November twenty seventeen.

events.label: No board meetings held after this

say.text: The law requires a welfare fund. The audit found the board never set one up. So the cess collected is held in a government account.

mark: had not constituted the Welfare Fund

say.text: Active registered workers fell from about four lakh sixty-eight thousand in March twenty eighteen, to about one lakh fifty-seven thousand in March twenty twenty-two.
That is a fall of two in every three.
Thirteen of thirty-one welfare schemes were closed or on hold. The old age pension has been on hold since May twenty nineteen. And no annual report was prepared for twenty seventeen to twenty-two.

items.text: 13 of 31 welfare schemes closed or on hold
Old age pension on hold since May 2019
